verdict.rationale: Scribe's own Text Polishing feature improves punctuation, capitalization and grammar. It returns the polished text separately under outputs.text_polishing.text and never overwrites the original transcript under result, so a developer can choose formatted or unformatted output. Missing for 10: any evidence of number formatting (inverse text normalization), an explicit formatting on/off parameter for the base transcript, documentation that base transcripts are punctuated and cased by default, and independent corroboration.
